answer_1.quote: Text summarization techniques aim to generate a condensed and cohesive version of the input text, enabling readers to grasp the main points without reading the full text.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model with the official ROUGE toolkit. We report the F1 score of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: Since the readability (how easy it is to understand) and informativeness (how much important information is captured) are difficult to measure automatically, three expert annotators are involved to conduct manual evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: They rate the readability and the informativeness of 100 instances sampled from the test set on a scale of 1 to 5 (with 5 being the best).
